title: binte sheh kehti thi haaye qasim bane
body:
binte sheh kehti thi haaye qasim bane
bewa mai hogayi haaye qasim bane
mera raaj gaya sar ka taaj gaya
aaj mai lut gayi- haaye qasim bane
<<DIVIDER>>
thi dulhan raat ko ab hu bewa suno
kya bane par bani- haaye qasim bane
maang me meri tha shab ko sandal laga
ab hai mitti bhari- haaye qasim bane
<<DIVIDER>>
tum jo ghar se gaye qoo'n me laal hue
kaisi mehndi lagi- haaye qasim bane
hai ye kaisa ghazab bewa kehte hai sab kyu na mai mar gayi- haaye qasim bane
shab me dulha bane, sub'ha jangal base
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi shaadi rachi- haaye qasim bane
choodio me jo thi reesmaa'n se bandhi
wo kalaai meri- haaye qasim bane
